title: Wolf Workspace assistant turn
description: One finished task of the Workspace assistant (wolfsdk.assistant.v1): a request a signed-in user made from the panel beside a document, the tool steps the assistant took with the tools of wolfsdk.mcp-workspace.v1, the proposals it opened, its answer, and the tokens the model used. $defs.clientMessage and $defs.serverEvent describe the JSON text messages a Workspace server exchanges with that user's connection, beside wolfsdk.room.v1 and never inside it: a room message is never an assistant message, and assistant events go only to the connection that asked. $defs.usageSummary is the usage of one workspace in one calendar month. The assistant never commits: every change it makes is a proposal of the room, decided by a user. Every timestamp is an RFC 3339 UTC instant, and a month is a calendar month in UTC.

conversation_id.description: The conversation the task belongs to: the tasks of one conversation are the context of the next.

user.description: Who asked, and whose seat the task counts against.

assistant.description: The agent actor the assistant acted as in the room: the author of its proposals.

answer.description: The text the assistant answered with; empty when it gave none.

failure.description: Why the task failed, for outcome failed; null otherwise.

proposal_ids.description: The proposals the task opened, in the order of the steps that opened them.

model.description: The model name the server was configured with.

month.description: A calendar month in UTC, such as 2026-11.

askText.description: What the user asked, at most 16000 characters.

outcome.description: How the task ended. proposed: it opened at least one proposal. answered: it answered without changing anything. cancelled: the user stopped it. failed: the model or the server could not finish it. turn_limit and token_limit: it reached a cap of the server. A task that ended any other way than answered may still have opened proposals.

stepStatus.description: running: the tool call has started. ok: it returned a result. failed: the tool refused it, or it did not finish.

step.description: One tool call of a task. A server announces a step when it starts and again when it ends, under the same number.
1-based position among the steps of the task.

doc_name.description: The document the call names, or null when it names none.

summary.description: One line a person can read: what was read, changed or refused.

proposal_id.description: The proposal of the room this step opened.

doc_name.description: The document open beside the panel, or null.

target_address.description: The selection in that document, as an Agent API address, or null.

usage.description: Tokens of the chat-completions calls of a task, or of the tasks summed. cached_tokens is the part of prompt_tokens the provider served from its prompt cache.

allowance.description: The assistant tasks of one seat in one calendar month. A task counts when its first model call is made. At the limit the assistant stops until resets_at; every other function of the room is unaffected.

limit.description: Tasks the seat may start in the month, or null when the server does not meter.

resets_at.description: The first instant of the next month.

usageSummary.description: The assistant usage of one workspace in one calendar month: its counted tasks and their tokens, in total and per seat.

assistantState.description: ready: a request will be taken. not_configured: the server has no model endpoint. allowance_exhausted: the seat has used its tasks for the month.

model.description: The configured model name; null when not configured.

allowance.description: The allowance of the asking seat; null when not configured.

ev_task_started.description: The server took an ask: the task has an id, and the allowance already counts it.

ev_text.description: The next piece of the answer, in order.

ev_task_finished.description: The last event of a task: the turn as it was stored.

ev_conversation.description: The answer to assistant.history: the stored turns of one conversation, oldest first; a null conversation_id and no turns when the user has none in the room.

ev_error.description: A refused assistant message. Nothing was started and nothing counts against the allowance.

ev_allowance_exhausted.description: An ask refused because the seat has used its tasks for the month. The assistant stops; editing, review, comments and outside agents continue.

msg_status.description: Ask whether the assistant is available to this seat. Answered by assistant.status.

msg_ask.description: Start a task. Answered by assistant.task.started, then steps and text, then assistant.task.finished; or by assistant.error.

conversation_id.description: The conversation to continue, or null to start one.

doc_name.description: The document open beside the panel, or null.

target_address.description: The selection in that document, as an Agent API address, or null.

msg_cancel.description: Stop a running task of this user. The task ends with assistant.task.finished and outcome cancelled.

msg_history.description: Ask for the stored turns of a conversation of this user in the room, or of the latest one with null. Answered by assistant.conversation.
